physicalNotes: Radius 1.26 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 51 Peg b does not transit (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 90,079.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.61 +/- 0.06 Jupiter masses (Cont et al. (2026), A&A 710, A345, Table 1: 0.61 (+0.06, -0.05) Jupiter masses, from the Doppler shift of the planet's own spectral lines, https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23582) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
